title: Exponential-time acceptance language
statement: The language consists of exactly those Boolean strings $z$ for which there exist Boolean strings $\alpha,x$ and a natural number $n$ such that $z$ is the pairing of $\alpha$ with the pairing of $x$ and the length-$n$ string of true bits, and the machine decoded from $\alpha$ outputs $[\mathrm{true}]$ on $x$ in exactly $2^n$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: There exist Boolean strings α and x and a natural number n
z equals the specified nested pair encoding
The decoded machine computes output [true] on x in exactly 2^n steps
